## What this is (the human version)

Google just shipped **[Antigravity CLI](https://developers.googleblog.com/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/)** — the terminal coding agent that replaces Gemini CLI, invoked as the `agy` binary ([docs](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli-using)). This PR teaches the SpecStory CLI to capture those sessions, so anything you do with `agy` shows up as clean markdown history (and syncs to SpecStory Cloud) exactly like Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Droid CLI, and DeepSeek TUI already do.

In other words: **`specstory sync antigravity` now works.** Run Antigravity in your project, then sync, and you get a readable transcript of your prompts, the model's reasoning, every tool call, and the results.

## How it works

Antigravity stores each conversation as an append-only JSONL transcript buried at:

```
~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl
```

The new `antigravity` provider parses those step-by-step transcripts, groups them into conversation turns, stitches each tool result back onto the tool call that produced it, and renders Antigravity's tools (`run_command`, `view_file`, `write_to_file`, `replace_file_content`, `grep_search`, `list_dir`, …) into the unified SpecStory markdown format.

## The interesting/tricky bits

A few things made Antigravity different from every provider we've added so far — worth a look in review:

- **Binary is `agy`** (not `antigravity`); version via `agy --version`, resume via `--conversation <id>`.
- **Tool results are separate transcript steps with no call→result id**, so results are matched to their originating tool call positionally (FIFO). Async/long-running command output (which lands in a separate `tasks/task-N.log`) is folded back in too.
- **Transcripts carry no workspace field**, and `history.jsonl` only logs *interactive* sessions (not `agy -p` print mode). So the workspace is taken from history when available and otherwise **inferred from the absolute paths the tools touched**. Text-only sessions with no recoverable workspace are returned only on explicit `-s <id>` requests, never in project-filtered bulk listings (so they can't pollute unrelated projects).
- **The watcher** establishes fsnotify watches level-by-level as that deeply-nested transcript directory gets created, since fsnotify isn't recursive.

The full reverse-engineered on-disk format is documented in [`docs/antigravity-format-spec.md`](specstory-cli/docs/antigravity-format-spec.md) for future maintainers.

## What's included

- New `pkg/providers/antigravitycli/` package (modeled on the `deepseektui` provider), with a test file per source file (~70 cases).
- Registered in the provider factory; `antigravity_cmd` config support.
- `docs/antigravity-format-spec.md`, plus README + changelog updates.

## Testing

- Built and verified end-to-end against **real captured `agy` sessions** (interactive `run_command`, file edits/reads/search, multi-turn continuations, failed commands, and text-only sessions) via `specstory sync antigravity -s <id> --print`.
- `specstory check antigravity` detects the real binary (v1.0.2).
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `golangci-lint run ./...` (0 issues), and `go test ./...` (all pass) are green.

```text
33	// Check verifies that the Antigravity CLI is available and returns its resolved
34	// location and version (`agy --version` prints a bare semver such as "1.1.3").
35	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
36		cmdName, _ := parseCommand(customCommand)
37		isCustom := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != ""
38		slog.Info("Check: verifying Antigravity CLI installation",
39			"command", cmdName, "customCommand", isCustom)
40	
41		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
42		if err != nil {
43			slog.Info("Check: binary not found on PATH", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
44			msg := buildCheckErrorMessage("not_found", cmdName, isCustom, "")
45			trackCheckFailure(providerID, isCustom, cmdName, "", versionFlag, "", "not_found", err.Error())
46			return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: "", ErrorMessage: msg}
47		}
48		slog.Info("Check: binary resolved", "command", cmdName, "resolved", resolved)
49	
50		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
51		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
52		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
53		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
54		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
55			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
56			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
57			slog.Info("Check: version probe failed",
58				"resolved", resolved, "errorType", errorType, "stderr", stderrOutput, "error", err)
59			msg := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, resolved, isCustom, stderrOutput)
60			trackCheckFailure(providerID, isCustom, cmdName, resolved, versionFlag, stderrOutput, errorType, err.Error())
61			return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: resolved, ErrorMessage: msg}
62		}
63	
64		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
65		if version == "" {
66			version = "unknown"
67		}
68		slog.Info("Check: succeeded", "resolved", resolved, "version", version)
69		trackCheckSuccess(providerID, isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version, versionFlag)
70		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
71	}

201	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Antigravity CLI for the given project and
202	// watches for transcript updates.
203	func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
204		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: starting Antigravity CLI execution and monitoring",
205			"projectPath", projectPath,
206			"customCommand", customCommand,
207			"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
208			"debugRaw", debugRaw,
209			"hasCallback", sessionCallback != nil)
210	
211		if sessionCallback == nil {
212			slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: no callback provided, running without watcher")
213			return ExecuteAntigravity(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
214		}
215	
216		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
217		defer cancel()
218	
219		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: launching session watcher in background")
220		watchErr := make(chan error, 1)
221		go func() {
222			watchErr <- watchSessions(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
223		}()
224	
225		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: executing Antigravity CLI", "command", customCommand)
226		err := ExecuteAntigravity(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
227		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Antigravity CLI exited, stopping watcher", "execError", err)
228		cancel()
229	
230		if werr := <-watchErr; werr != nil && !errors.Is(werr, context.Canceled) {
231			slog.Warn("ExecAgentAndWatch: watcher stopped with error", "error", werr)
232		}
233	
234		if err != nil {
235			return fmt.Errorf("antigravity execution failed: %w", err)
236		}
237		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: complete")
238		return nil
239	}

241	// WatchAgent monitors Antigravity CLI sessions for the given project and invokes
242	// sessionCallback for each new or updated session until ctx is canceled.
243	func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
244		slog.Info("WatchAgent: starting Antigravity CLI activity monitoring",
245			"projectPath", projectPath, "debugRaw", debugRaw)
246		if sessionCallback == nil {
247			return fmt.Errorf("session callback is required")
248		}
249		err := watchSessions(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
250		slog.Info("WatchAgent: watcher exited", "error", err)

254	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every Antigravity session across all
255	// projects, one ref per conversation that has a parseable transcript. Unlike the
256	// project-scoped listing, the project is discovered rather than supplied: each
257	// ref carries the session's resolved workspace as OriginCwd so `specstory
258	// reindex` can map it to a project. Enumeration is keyed off the brain/ dirs
259	// (the transcript-backed conversations) rather than conversations/*.db, since
260	// only the former yield conversation content this provider can read. See
261	// docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
262	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
263		files, err := listConversationFiles()
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		history, _ := loadHistoryIndex()
268		projectWorkspaces, _ := loadConversationWorkspaceIndex()
269		summaries, _ := loadConversationSummaryIndex()
270	
271		var refs []spi.GlobalSessionRef
272		for _, file := range files {
273			session, err := parseTranscript(file.ConversationID, file.Path, history, projectWorkspaces, false)
274			if err != nil {
275				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping session during global enumeration",
276					"conversationId", file.ConversationID, "error", err)
277				continue
278			}
279			meta := sessionMetadata(session, history, summaries)
280			if meta == nil {
281				// No user prompt — nothing resumable/indexable.
282				continue
283			}
284			refs = append(refs, spi.GlobalSessionRef{
285				SessionID:  meta.SessionID,
286				CreatedAt:  meta.CreatedAt,
287				Slug:       meta.Slug,
288				Name:       meta.Name,
289				NativePath: file.Path,
290				OriginCwd:  session.Workspace,
291			})
292		}
293		return refs, nil
294	}
295	
296	// --- helpers shared across the package ---
297	
298	func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
299		var execErr *exec.Error
300		var pathErr *os.PathError
301		switch {
302		case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
303			return "not_found"
304		case errors.As(err, &pathErr) && errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission):
305			return "permission_denied"
306		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
307			return "permission_denied"
308		default:
309			return "version_failed"
310		}
311	}
312	
313	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
314		var builder strings.Builder
315		switch errorType {
316		case "not_found":
317			builder.WriteString("Antigravity CLI was not found.\n\n")
318			if isCustom {
319				builder.WriteString("• Verify the custom path you provided is executable.\n")
320				fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "• Provided command: %s\n", command)
321			} else {
322				builder.WriteString("• Install the Antigravity CLI and ensure `agy` is on your PATH.\n")
323				builder.WriteString("• Re-run `specstory check antigravity` after installation.\n")
324			}
325		case "permission_denied":
326			builder.WriteString("SpecStory cannot execute the Antigravity CLI due to permissions.\n\n")
327			fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "Try: chmod +x %s\n", command)
328		default:
329			builder.WriteString("`agy --version` failed.\n\n")
330			if stderr != "" {
331				builder.WriteString("Error output:\n")
332				builder.WriteString(stderr)
333				builder.WriteString("\n\n")
334			}
335			builder.WriteString("Run `agy --version` manually to diagnose, then retry.")
336		}
337		return builder.String()
338	}
339	
340	func trackCheckSuccess(provider string, custom bool, commandPath string, resolvedPath string, version string, versionFlag string) {
341		props := analytics.Properties{
342			"provider":       provider,
343			"custom_command": custom,
344			"command_path":   commandPath,
345			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
346			"version":        version,
347			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
348		}
349		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, props)
350	}
351

353		props := analytics.Properties{
354			"provider":       provider,
355			"custom_command": custom,

364		}
```

```text
95	// isToolResultStep reports whether a step carries a tool result. Results are

98	// (PLANNER_RESPONSE), or the system scaffolding (CONVERSATION_HISTORY,

101	// SEARCH_WEB, READ_URL_CONTENT, GENERATE_IMAGE, INVOKE_SUBAGENT, ASK_QUESTION)

103	func isToolResultStep(step transcriptStep) bool {

106			return false
107		default:
108			return true
109		}

112	// loadHistoryIndex reads history.jsonl and returns a map conversationId →
113	// historyEntry. Lines without a conversationId (the first prompt of each
114	// session) are skipped because they cannot be attributed to a conversation yet;
115	// any later line for that session carries the id and the same workspace. A
116	// missing file yields an empty map and a nil error.
117	func loadHistoryIndex() (map[string]historyEntry, error) {
118		path, err := resolveHistoryPath()
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, err
121		}
122	
123		f, err := os.Open(path)
124		if err != nil {
125			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
126				return map[string]historyEntry{}, nil
127			}
128			return nil, fmt.Errorf("antigravity: cannot open history file: %w", err)
129		}
130		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
131	
132		index := make(map[string]historyEntry)
133		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
134		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), maxTranscriptLineSize)
135		for scanner.Scan() {
136			line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
137			if line == "" {
138				continue
139			}
140			var entry historyEntry
141			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
142				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping malformed history line", "error", err)
143				continue
144			}
145			if entry.ConversationID == "" {
146				continue
147			}
148			index[entry.ConversationID] = entry
149		}
150		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
151			return nil, fmt.Errorf("antigravity: cannot scan history file: %w", err)
152		}
153	
154		return index, nil
155	}
156	
157	// parseTranscript reads a conversation's transcript JSONL file and returns an
158	// agSession. When wantRawData is true the full file bytes are retained on
159	// RawData for cloud sync / debug-raw output; callers that only need the parsed
160	// structure pass false to avoid keeping a copy of the whole file in memory.
161	func parseTranscript(conversationID, transcriptPath string, history map[string]historyEntry, projectWorkspaces map[string]string, wantRawData bool) (*agSession, error) {
162		data, err := os.ReadFile(transcriptPath)
163		if err != nil {
164			return nil, fmt.Errorf("antigravity: cannot read transcript %s: %w", transcriptPath, err)
165		}
166	
167		// transcript.jsonl double-encodes every tool-arg value; transcript_full.jsonl
168		// stores them natively. We only need to unescape when we fell back to the
169		// former (see resolveTranscriptPath).
170		fromFallback := strings.HasSuffix(transcriptPath, fallbackTranscriptFileName)
171	
172		var steps []transcriptStep
173		for _, rawLine := range bytes.Split(data, []byte{'\n'}) {
174			line := bytes.TrimSpace(rawLine)
175			if len(line) == 0 {
176				continue
177			}
178			var step transcriptStep
179			if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &step); err != nil {
180				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping malformed transcript line",
181					"conversationId", conversationID, "error", err)
182				continue
183			}
184			if fromFallback {
185				for i := range step.ToolCalls {
186					step.ToolCalls[i].Args = normalizeFallbackArgs(step.ToolCalls[i].Args)
187				}
188			}
189			steps = append(steps, step)
190		}
191	
192		// agy flushes async tool results to the transcript as they complete, so file
193		// order can place a result line ahead of the PLANNER_RESPONSE that carries its
194		// call. Sort by step_index (the canonical monotonic sequence) so call/result
195		// correlation and the first/last timestamps below are computed on the true
196		// order. A stable sort keeps file order for any equal indices.
197		sort.SliceStable(steps, func(i, j int) bool {
198			return steps[i].StepIndex < steps[j].StepIndex
199		})
200	
201		session := &agSession{
202			ConversationID: conversationID,
203			Steps:          steps,
204		}
205		if taskOutputs, err := loadTaskOutputs(transcriptPath); err == nil {
206			session.TaskOutputs = taskOutputs
207		} else {
208			slog.Debug("antigravity: failed to load async task outputs",
209				"conversationId", conversationID, "error", err)
210		}
211		if len(steps) > 0 {
212			session.CreatedAt = strings.TrimSpace(steps[0].CreatedAt)
213			session.UpdatedAt = strings.TrimSpace(steps[len(steps)-1].CreatedAt)
214		}
215		session.Workspace = resolveSessionWorkspace(conversationID, steps, history, projectWorkspaces)
216		session.Model = deriveModel(steps)
217		if wantRawData {
218			session.RawData = string(data)
219		}
220	
221		return session, nil
222	}
223	
224	// loadTaskOutputs reads optional async command logs from
225	// .system_generated/tasks/task-<step_index>.log. Antigravity names the task log
226	// after the RUN_COMMAND result step that remains RUNNING in the transcript.
227	func loadTaskOutputs(transcriptPath string) (map[int]string, error) {
228		systemDir := filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath))
229		tasksDir := filepath.Join(systemDir, "tasks")
230		entries, err := os.ReadDir(tasksDir)
231		if err != nil {
232			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
233				return nil, nil
234			}
235			return nil, err
236		}
237	
238		outputs := make(map[int]string)
239		for _, entry := range entries {
240			if entry.IsDir() {
241				continue
242			}
243			name := entry.Name()
244			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "task-") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".log") {
245				continue
246			}
247			stepIndex, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "task-"), ".log"))
248			if err != nil {
249				continue
250			}
251			data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(tasksDir, name))
252			if err != nil {
253				continue
254			}
255			if text := strings.TrimSpace(string(data)); text != "" {
256				outputs[stepIndex] = text
257			}
258		}
259		return outputs, nil
260	}
261	
262	// normalizeFallbackArgs unescapes the double-encoded arg values found in
263	// transcript.jsonl. Each value there is itself a JSON-encoded scalar
264	// (string→string, "false"→bool, "5000"→int); decoding it once more recovers the
265	// native value. Values that don't decode are left as-is.
266	func normalizeFallbackArgs(args map[string]any) map[string]any {
267		if len(args) == 0 {
268			return args
269		}
270		out := make(map[string]any, len(args))
271		for k, v := range args {
272			s, ok := v.(string)
273			if !ok {
274				out[k] = v
275				continue
276			}
277			var decoded any
278			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(s), &decoded); err == nil {
279				out[k] = decoded
280			} else {
281				out[k] = s
282			}
283		}
284		return out
285	}

287	// sessionMetadata builds lightweight spi.SessionMetadata from an already-parsed
288	// session. Returns nil when the conversation has no usable user prompt — callers
289	// treat that as "skip".
290	func sessionMetadata(session *agSession, history map[string]historyEntry, summaries map[string]conversationSummary) *spi.SessionMetadata {
291		prompt := firstUserPromptText(session)
292		if prompt == "" {
293			return nil
294		}
295	
296		slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(prompt)
297		if slug == "" {
298			slug = fallbackSlug
299		}
300	
301		createdAt := session.CreatedAt
302		if createdAt == "" {
303			if entry, ok := history[session.ConversationID]; ok {
304				createdAt = msEpochToRFC3339(entry.Timestamp)
305			}
306		}
307	
308		// Prefer Antigravity's own generated conversation title/preview when present;
309		// it is a cleaner label than one derived from the raw first prompt. The
310		// summaries store is partial and async, so fall back to the derived name.
311		name := spi.GenerateReadableName(prompt)
312		if best := summaries[session.ConversationID].bestName(); best != "" {
313			name = best
314		}
315	
316		return &spi.SessionMetadata{
317			SessionID: session.ConversationID,
318			CreatedAt: createdAt,
319			Slug:      slug,
320			Name:      name,
321		}
322	}
323	
324	// firstUserPromptText returns the cleaned text of the first USER_INPUT step that
325	// carries a real prompt, or "" if none.
326	func firstUserPromptText(session *agSession) string {
327		for _, step := range session.Steps {
328			if step.Type != typeUserInput {
329				continue
330			}
331			if text := cleanUserPrompt(step.Content); text != "" {
332				return text
333			}
334		}
335		return ""
336	}
```

```text
55	// convertToAgentSession converts a parsed agSession into the unified
56	// AgentChatSession format. Returns nil for empty/unconvertible sessions.
57	func convertToAgentSession(session *agSession, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
58		if session == nil || len(session.Steps) == 0 {
59			return nil
60		}
61	
62		sessionData, err := generateAgentSession(session, workspaceRoot)
63		if err != nil {
64			slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping session due to conversion error",

66			return nil
67		}

69		if debugRaw {
70			writeDebugRaw(session)
71		}

74			SessionID:   session.ConversationID,
75			CreatedAt:   sessionData.CreatedAt,

82	// generateAgentSession converts an agSession into the shared SessionData schema.
83	func generateAgentSession(session *agSession, workspaceRoot string) (*SessionData, error) {
84		// Prefer the session's own resolved workspace; fall back to the project the
85		// CLI is syncing from so WorkspaceRoot is never empty.
86		workspace := strings.TrimSpace(workspaceRoot)
87		if ws := strings.TrimSpace(session.Workspace); ws != "" {
88			workspace = ws
89		}
90	
91		exchanges := buildExchanges(session, workspace)
92		if len(exchanges) == 0 {
93			return nil, fmt.Errorf("session contains no conversational exchanges")
94		}
95	
96		created := strings.TrimSpace(session.CreatedAt)
97		updated := strings.TrimSpace(session.UpdatedAt)
98		if updated == "" {
99			updated = created
100		}
101	
102		// Provider.Version must be non-empty for schema validation. Antigravity does
103		// not stamp the model on every step, so we use the model derived from the
104		// first turn's settings block and fall back to "unknown".
105		version := strings.TrimSpace(session.Model)
106		if version == "" {
107			version = "unknown"
108		}
109	
110		// Antigravity surfaces no per-step token usage in the transcript, so — like
111		// DeepSeek TUI — we intentionally do not synthesize a schema.Usage value.
112	
113		data := &SessionData{
114			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
115			Provider: ProviderInfo{
116				ID:      providerSchemaID,
117				Name:    providerName,
118				Version: version,
119			},
120			SessionID:     session.ConversationID,
121			CreatedAt:     created,
122			UpdatedAt:     updated,
123			Slug:          deriveSlug(session),
124			WorkspaceRoot: workspace,
125			Exchanges:     exchanges,
126		}

131	// buildExchanges groups transcript steps into exchanges. Steps are processed in
132	// file order (NOT by step_index — the index has a benign gap at 4). Each
133	// USER_INPUT starts a new exchange; PLANNER_RESPONSE adds an agent text message
134	// plus one message per tool call; a tool-result step attaches its output to the
135	// matching pending tool message.
136	func buildExchanges(session *agSession, workspaceRoot string) []Exchange {
137		var exchanges []Exchange
138		var current *Exchange
139	
140		flush := func() {
141			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
142				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
143			}
144		}
145	
146		for _, step := range session.Steps {
147			switch {
148			case step.Type == typeUserInput && step.Source == sourceUserExplicit:
149				flush()
150				current = &Exchange{}
151				msg := convertUserStep(step)
152				if len(msg.Content) > 0 {
153					current.Messages = append(current.Messages, msg)
154					current.StartTime = step.CreatedAt
155					current.EndTime = step.CreatedAt
156				}
157	
158			case step.Type == typePlannerResponse:
159				if current == nil {
160					current = &Exchange{}
161				}
162				current.Messages = append(current.Messages, convertPlannerStep(step, session.ConversationID, session.Model, workspaceRoot)...)
163				current.EndTime = step.CreatedAt
164	
165			case isToolResultStep(step):
166				// Tool results carry source MODEL and follow their PLANNER_RESPONSE;
167				// they are not new turns.
168				if current != nil {
169					attachToolResult(step, current, session.TaskOutputs)
170					current.EndTime = step.CreatedAt
171				}
172	
173			case step.Type == typeConversationHistory, step.Type == typeSystemMessage, step.Type == typeCheckpoint:
174				// Replayed context / injected notices / truncation markers — not
175				// user-visible turn content.
176				continue
177	
178			default:
179				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping unrecognized step",
180					"conversationId", session.ConversationID, "type", step.Type, "stepIndex", step.StepIndex)
181			}
182		}
183	
184		flush()
185	
186		for i := range exchanges {
187			exchanges[i].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.ConversationID, i)
188			if exchanges[i].StartTime == "" {
189				exchanges[i].StartTime = session.CreatedAt
190			}
191			if exchanges[i].EndTime == "" {
192				exchanges[i].EndTime = exchanges[i].StartTime
193			}
194		}
195	
196		return exchanges
197	}
198	
199	// convertUserStep converts a USER_INPUT step to a schema user message, stripping
200	// the <USER_REQUEST> wrapper and metadata blocks. Returns a zero-value Message
201	// (empty Content) when nothing user-visible remains; callers drop it.
202	func convertUserStep(step transcriptStep) Message {
203		text := cleanUserPrompt(step.Content)
204		if text == "" {
205			return Message{}
206		}
207		return Message{
208			Timestamp: step.CreatedAt,
209			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
210			Content:   []ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: text}},
211		}
212	}
213	
214	// convertPlannerStep converts a PLANNER_RESPONSE into an ordered set of messages:
215	// an optional agent message carrying the model's thinking + reply text, followed
216	// by one message per tool call.
217	func convertPlannerStep(step transcriptStep, conversationID, model, workspaceRoot string) []Message {
218		var msgs []Message
219	
220		var parts []ContentPart
221		if thinking := strings.TrimSpace(step.Thinking); thinking != "" {
222			parts = append(parts, ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: thinking})
223		}
224		if text := strings.TrimSpace(step.Content); text != "" {
225			parts = append(parts, ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: text})
226		}
227		if len(parts) > 0 {
228			msgs = append(msgs, Message{
229				Timestamp: step.CreatedAt,
230				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
231				Model:     model,
232				Content:   parts,
233			})
234		}
235	
236		for idx, tc := range step.ToolCalls {
237			// Antigravity tool calls carry no explicit id, so synthesize a stable one
238			// from the conversation + step + tool position.
239			useID := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d:%d", conversationID, step.StepIndex, idx)
240			msgs = append(msgs, convertToolCallMessage(tc, useID, model, step.CreatedAt, workspaceRoot))
241		}
242	
243		return msgs
244	}
245	
246	// convertToolCallMessage builds an agent Message for a single tool call. The
247	// FormattedMarkdown is set from the input here; attachToolResult re-renders it
248	// once the matching result step lands.
249	func convertToolCallMessage(tc transcriptToolCall, useID, model, timestamp, workspaceRoot string) Message {
250		name := tc.Name
251		if name == "" {
252			name = "unknown"
253		}
254		tool := &ToolInfo{
255			Name:  name,
256			Type:  classifyToolType(name),
257			UseID: useID,
258			Input: tc.Args,
259		}
260		if formatted := formatToolCall(tool); formatted != "" {
261			tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formatted
262		}
263		return Message{
264			Timestamp: timestamp,
265			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
266			Model:     model,
267			Tool:      tool,
268			PathHints: extractPathHints(tc.Args, workspaceRoot),
269		}
270	}
271	
272	// attachToolResult routes a tool-result step's content to a pending tool message
273	// in the current exchange (one that has not yet received output). Antigravity
274	// transcripts carry no call→result id, so correlation is by tool type first
275	// (route the result to a pending call whose type matches the result's category),
276	// falling back to the oldest pending call (positional/FIFO). The type check keeps
277	// results correctly paired when several calls are in flight and complete out of
278	// order. After attaching, the tool's FormattedMarkdown is re-rendered to include
279	// the output.
280	func attachToolResult(step transcriptStep, current *Exchange, taskOutputs map[int]string) {
281		content := cleanResultContent(step)
282		if strings.EqualFold(step.Status, "RUNNING") {
283			if taskOutput := strings.TrimSpace(taskOutputs[step.StepIndex]); taskOutput != "" {
284				if content != "" {
285					content += "\n\nTask output:\n" + taskOutput
286				} else {
287					content = taskOutput
288				}
289			}
290		}
291		tool := pickPendingTool(current, resultStepToolType(step.Type))
292		if tool == nil {
293			slog.Debug("antigravity: tool result with no pending tool call", "type", step.Type, "stepIndex", step.StepIndex)
294			return
295		}
296		tool.Output = map[string]any{"content": content}
297		if formatted := formatToolCall(tool); formatted != "" {
298			tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formatted
299		}
300	}
301	
302	// pickPendingTool selects the tool message a result should attach to: the oldest
303	// pending (output-less) tool whose Type equals wantType, or — when wantType is
304	// empty (ambiguous result category) or none matches — the oldest pending tool of
305	// any type. Returns nil when no tool is awaiting output.
306	func pickPendingTool(current *Exchange, wantType string) *ToolInfo {
307		var fallback *ToolInfo
308		for i := range current.Messages {
309			tool := current.Messages[i].Tool
310			if tool == nil || tool.Output != nil {
311				continue
312			}
313			if fallback == nil {
314				fallback = tool
315			}
316			if wantType != "" && tool.Type == wantType {
317				return tool
318			}
319		}
320		return fallback
321	}
322	
323	// resultStepToolType maps an Antigravity result step type to the SpecStory tool
324	// type (schema.ToolType*) the originating call carries on ToolInfo.Type, so a
325	// result can be routed to the matching pending call. Result types without a clean
326	// 1:1 mapping — GENERIC and the dedicated new-tool result types — return "", which
327	// tells pickPendingTool to fall back to positional (FIFO) attachment.
328	func resultStepToolType(resultType string) string {
329		switch resultType {
330		case typeRunCommand:
331			return schema.ToolTypeShell
332		case typeViewFile, typeListDirectory:
333			return schema.ToolTypeRead
334		case typeCodeAction:
335			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
336		case typeGrepSearch:
337			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
338		default:
339			return ""
340		}
341	}
342	
343	// resultBoilerplate are framework filler phrases agy appends to tool results.
344	// They are instructions to the model, not information for a human reader, so they
345	// are stripped from rendered output. Matched as substrings because agy sometimes
346	// appends them inline to a content line (e.g. right after "The following changes
347	// were made … to: <path>.").
348	var resultBoilerplate = []string{
349		"If relevant, proactively run terminal commands to execute this code for the USER. Don't ask for permission.",
350		"Please note that the above snippet only shows the MODIFIED lines from the last change. It shows up to 3 lines of unchanged lines before and after the modified lines. The actual file contents may have many more lines not shown.",
351		"Do not output the path of this image to show to the user since the user can already see it. However, you can embed this image in artifacts for the USER's review.",
352		"The subagents will send you a message when they have completed their task or require guidance. There is no need to poll for their responses.",
353		"You can use the view_file tool to read specific sections if needed.",
354	}
355	
356	// cleanResultContent normalizes a tool result's content for display: it strips
357	// the per-result "Created At:"/"Completed At:" timing header (redundant with the
358	// turn timestamps), the leading tab indentation agy inserts into RUN_COMMAND
359	// output blocks, and the framework boilerplate above, then collapses the blank
360	// lines those removals leave behind.
361	func cleanResultContent(step transcriptStep) string {
362		content := strings.TrimSpace(step.Content)
363		if content == "" {
364			return ""
365		}
366		for _, phrase := range resultBoilerplate {
367			content = strings.ReplaceAll(content, phrase, "")
368		}
369		lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
370		kept := make([]string, 0, len(lines))
371		for _, line := range lines {
372			line = strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimLeft(line, "\t"), " \t")
373			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Created At:") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "Completed At:") {
374				continue
375			}
376			kept = append(kept, line)
377		}
378		return collapseBlankLines(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(kept, "\n")))
379	}
380	
381	// collapseBlankLines reduces any run of blank lines to a single blank line, so
382	// content stays readable after header/boilerplate removal opens gaps.
383	func collapseBlankLines(s string) string {
384		var b strings.Builder
385		blank := false
386		for _, line := range strings.Split(s, "\n") {
387			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
388				if blank {
389					continue
390				}
391				blank = true
392			} else {
393				blank = false
394			}
395			b.WriteString(line)
396			b.WriteString("\n")
397		}
398		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
399	}

401	// cleanUserPrompt extracts the real prompt from a USER_INPUT content blob.
402	func cleanUserPrompt(raw string) string {
403		if m := userRequestRe.FindStringSubmatch(raw); len(m) == 2 {
404			return strings.TrimSpace(m[1])
405		}
406		// No wrapper (defensive): drop any metadata blocks and return the remainder.
407		cleaned := metadataBlockRe.ReplaceAllString(raw, "")
408		return strings.TrimSpace(cleaned)
409	}

411	// deriveSlug builds a filename-safe slug from the first user prompt.
412	func deriveSlug(session *agSession) string {
413		if prompt := firstUserPromptText(session); prompt != "" {
414			if slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(prompt); slug != "" {
415				return slug
416			}
417		}
418		return fallbackSlug
419	}

421	// deriveModel extracts the model name from the first turn's settings-change
422	// block. Returns "" when no model is recorded (e.g. continuation-only captures).
423	func deriveModel(steps []transcriptStep) string {
424		for _, step := range steps {
425			if step.Type != typeUserInput {
426				continue
427			}
428			if m := modelRe.FindStringSubmatch(step.Content); len(m) == 2 {
429				return strings.TrimSpace(m[1])
430			}
431		}
432		return ""
433	}

435	// resolveSessionWorkspace determines the workspace a conversation belongs to.
436	// history.jsonl is authoritative when it has an entry (interactive sessions).
437	// Otherwise, retained CLI logs can join conversationId -> projectId -> workspace.
438	// Finally, the workspace is inferred as the common ancestor of absolute paths
439	// touched by tools. Returns "" when nothing is resolvable.
440	func resolveSessionWorkspace(conversationID string, steps []transcriptStep, history map[string]historyEntry, projectWorkspaces map[string]string) string {
441		if entry, ok := history[conversationID]; ok {
442			if ws := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Workspace); ws != "" {
443				return ws
444			}
445		}
446		if ws := strings.TrimSpace(projectWorkspaces[conversationID]); ws != "" {
447			return ws
448		}
449		return commonPathPrefix(collectWorkspacePaths(steps))
450	}
451	
452	// sessionWorkspaceKnown reports whether a session has any signal of which
453	// project it belongs to. Text-only print-mode sessions have neither a history
454	// entry nor tool paths, so their workspace is unknowable; such "unscoped"
455	// sessions are surfaced only on explicit by-id retrieval, never in project-
456	// filtered bulk listings (which would otherwise pollute every project).
457	func sessionWorkspaceKnown(session *agSession) bool {
458		return strings.TrimSpace(session.Workspace) != "" || len(collectToolPaths(session.Steps)) > 0
459	}
460	
461	// sessionMatchesProject reports whether a session belongs to projectPath. An
462	// empty projectPath matches every session (no filtering). A session matches when
463	// its resolved workspace and the project are nested either way, or when any tool
464	// touched a path inside the project.
465	func sessionMatchesProject(session *agSession, projectPath string) bool {
466		if strings.TrimSpace(projectPath) == "" {
467			return true
468		}
469		if session.Workspace != "" {
470			if pathWithin(session.Workspace, projectPath) || pathWithin(projectPath, session.Workspace) {
471				return true
472			}
473		}
474		for _, p := range collectToolPaths(session.Steps) {
475			if pathWithin(p, projectPath) {
476				return true
477			}
478		}
479		return false
480	}

482	// collectToolPaths gathers the absolute filesystem paths referenced by every
483	// tool call in the transcript, normalizing file:// URIs to plain paths.
484	func collectToolPaths(steps []transcriptStep) []string {
485		var paths []string
486		seen := make(map[string]bool)
487		for _, step := range steps {
488			for _, tc := range step.ToolCalls {
489				for _, key := range toolPathArgKeys {
490					val, ok := tc.Args[key].(string)
491					if !ok {
492						continue
493					}
494					appendUniqueAbsPath(&paths, seen, val)
495				}
496			}
497		}
498		return paths
499	}
500	
501	// collectWorkspacePaths gathers directory candidates for workspace inference.
502	// File-valued tool args are reduced to their parent directory; directory-valued
503	// args are used as-is.
504	func collectWorkspacePaths(steps []transcriptStep) []string {
505		var paths []string
506		seen := make(map[string]bool)
507		add := func(value string, fileValue bool) {
508			p := stripFileURI(strings.TrimSpace(value))
509			if p == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(p) {
510				return
511			}
512			if fileValue {
513				p = filepath.Dir(p)
514			}
515			appendUniqueAbsPath(&paths, seen, p)
516		}
517	
518		for _, step := range steps {
519			for _, tc := range step.ToolCalls {
520				for _, key := range workspaceDirArgKeys {
521					if val, ok := tc.Args[key].(string); ok {
522						add(val, false)
523					}
524				}
525				for _, key := range workspaceFileArgKeys {
526					if val, ok := tc.Args[key].(string); ok {
527						add(val, true)
528					}
529				}
530			}
531		}
532		return paths
533	}
534	
535	func appendUniqueAbsPath(paths *[]string, seen map[string]bool, value string) {
536		p := stripFileURI(strings.TrimSpace(value))
537		if p == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(p) || seen[p] {
538			return
539		}
540		seen[p] = true
541		*paths = append(*paths, p)
542	}
543	
544	// commonPathPrefix returns the deepest directory that is an ancestor of every
545	// given absolute path, or "" when the slice is empty or paths share no common
546	// root.
547	func commonPathPrefix(paths []string) string {
548		if len(paths) == 0 {
549			return ""
550		}
551	
552		split := func(p string) []string {
553			return strings.Split(filepath.Clean(p), string(filepath.Separator))
554		}
555	
556		common := split(paths[0])
557		for _, p := range paths[1:] {
558			parts := split(p)
559			n := len(common)
560			if len(parts) < n {
561				n = len(parts)
562			}
563			i := 0
564			for i < n && common[i] == parts[i] {
565				i++
566			}
567			common = common[:i]
568		}
569	
570		if len(common) <= 1 {
571			return ""
572		}
573		return strings.Join(common, string(filepath.Separator))
574	}
575	
576	// stripFileURI removes a leading file:// scheme and decodes escaped path bytes
577	// so URIs like file:///tmp/my%20file.go become /tmp/my file.go.
578	func stripFileURI(value string) string {
579		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
580		if !strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "file:") {
581			return trimmed
582		}
583		parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
584		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme == "file" {
585			if decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(parsed.Path); err == nil {
586				return decoded
587			}
588			return parsed.Path
589		}
590		return strings.TrimPrefix(trimmed, "file://")
591	}
592	
593	// msEpochToRFC3339 converts a millisecond epoch timestamp to an RFC3339 UTC
594	// string. Returns "" for non-positive input.
595	func msEpochToRFC3339(ms int64) string {
596		if ms <= 0 {
597			return ""
598		}
599		return time.UnixMilli(ms).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
600	}
601	
602	// writeDebugRaw writes the raw transcript to the debug directory when --debug-raw
603	// is set. The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
604	func writeDebugRaw(session *agSession) {
605		if session == nil || session.RawData == "" {
606			return
607		}
608		dir := spi.GetDebugDir(session.ConversationID)
609		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
610			slog.Debug("antigravity: unable to create debug dir", "error", err)
611			return
612		}
613		rawPath := filepath.Join(dir, "raw-transcript.jsonl")
614		if err := os.WriteFile(rawPath, []byte(session.RawData), 0o644); err != nil {
615			slog.Debug("antigravity: failed to write debug raw file", "path", rawPath, "error", err)
616			return
617		}
618		slog.Debug("antigravity: wrote debug raw file", "conversationId", session.ConversationID, "path", rawPath)
619	}
```

```text
162	// "not found", not an error.
163	func findTranscriptByID(conversationID string) (string, error) {
164		return resolveTranscriptPath(conversationID)
165	}
166	
167	// canonicalizePath resolves a path to its canonical form for comparison, so that
168	// symlinks and case-insensitive filesystems (macOS) compare equal.
169	func canonicalizePath(path string) string {
170		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
171		if trimmed == "" {
172			return ""
173		}
174		if canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(trimmed); err == nil {
175			return canonical
176		}
177		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(trimmed); err == nil {
178			return filepath.Clean(abs)
179		}
180		return filepath.Clean(trimmed)
181	}
182	
183	// pathWithin reports whether candidate is equal to or nested inside root, after
184	// canonicalizing both. Used to match a session's touched files against the
185	// project path the user is syncing from.
186	func pathWithin(candidate, root string) bool {
187		cRoot := canonicalizePath(root)
188		cCandidate := canonicalizePath(candidate)
189		if cRoot == "" || cCandidate == "" {
190			return false
191		}
192		if cCandidate == cRoot {
193			return true
194		}
195		rel, err := filepath.Rel(cRoot, cCandidate)
196		if err != nil {
197			return false
198		}
199		return rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
200	}
201
```

```text
263	func indexConversationProjectsFromLog(path string, index map[string]string) error {
264		f, err := os.Open(path)
265		if err != nil {
266			return err
267		}
268		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
269	
270		var currentProjectID string
271		var pendingConversationIDs []string
272		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
273		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), maxTranscriptLineSize)
274		for scanner.Scan() {
275			line := scanner.Text()
276			if projectID := projectIDFromLogLine(line); projectID != "" {
277				currentProjectID = projectID
278				for _, conversationID := range pendingConversationIDs {
279					index[conversationID] = currentProjectID
280				}
281				pendingConversationIDs = nil
282			}
283			for _, conversationID := range conversationIDsFromLogLine(line) {
284				if currentProjectID == "" {
285					pendingConversationIDs = append(pendingConversationIDs, conversationID)
286					continue
287				}
288				index[conversationID] = currentProjectID
289			}
290		}
291		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
292			return err
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	func projectIDFromLogLine(line string) string {
298		for _, re := range []*regexp.Regexp{projectIDFromConversationRe, projectIDFromUsingRe} {
299			if m := re.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(m) == 2 {
300				return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m[1]))
301			}
302		}
303		return ""
304	}
305	
306	func conversationIDsFromLogLine(line string) []string {
307		var ids []string
308		seen := make(map[string]bool)
309		for _, re := range conversationIDLogRes {
310			for _, m := range re.FindAllStringSubmatch(line, -1) {
311				if len(m) != 2 {
312					continue
313				}
314				id := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m[1]))
315				if id == "" || seen[id] {
316					continue
317				}
318				seen[id] = true
319				ids = append(ids, id)
320			}
321		}
322		return ids
323	}
```

133	func formatToolOutput(tool *ToolInfo) string {

141		}

143		// A few tools return a JSON blob (agy's protobuf-JSON, double-spaced and full
144		// of internal ids) that reads far better as a short summary. These are scoped
145		// by tool name so JSON-lines results (list_dir, grep_search) are never touched.
146		switch normalizeToolName(tool.Name) {
147		case "invokesubagent":
148			if s := formatInvokeSubagentOutput(content); s != "" {
149				return s

151		case "managesubagents":
152			if s := formatManageSubagentsOutput(content); s != "" {
153				return s
154			}
155		}

157		// agy's edit tools wrap the applied diff in [diff_block_start]/[diff_block_end];
158		// render it as a diff fence (any tool whose result carries the markers).
159		if s := formatDiffBlockOutput(content); s != "" {
160			return s
161		}

164			return fmt.Sprintf("Output:\n```text\n%s\n```", content)

174	// formatDiffBlockOutput reformats an agy edit-tool result — a lead sentence
175	// followed by a unified diff wrapped in [diff_block_start]/[diff_block_end]
176	// markers — into a ```diff fenced block. The lead line ("The following changes
177	// were made by the … tool to: <path>.") is dropped as redundant: the input block
178	// already shows the target path and the diff. Returns "" when no diff block is
179	// present, so the caller falls back to the raw output.
180	func formatDiffBlockOutput(content string) string {
181		start := strings.Index(content, diffBlockStartMarker)
182		end := strings.Index(content, diffBlockEndMarker)
183		if start == -1 || end == -1 || end < start {
184			return ""
185		}
186		diff := strings.TrimSpace(content[start+len(diffBlockStartMarker) : end])
187		if diff == "" {
188			return ""
189		}
190		return fmt.Sprintf("Output:\n```diff\n%s\n```", diff)
191	}

193	// formatInvokeSubagentOutput summarizes invoke_subagent's result JSON as one

197	func formatInvokeSubagentOutput(content string) string {
198		lead, objs, ok := splitLeadJSON(content)
199		if !ok {
200			return ""
201		}
202		var bullets []string
203		for _, o := range objs {
204			if id := stringValue(o, "conversationId"); id != "" {
205				bullets = append(bullets, fmt.Sprintf("- conversation `%s`", id))
206			}
207		}
208		if len(bullets) == 0 {
209			return ""
210		}
211		return joinOutput(defaultLead(lead, "Created subagents:"), bullets)
212	}

216	// placeholder, tier, initial prompt, and internal log URIs. Returns "" when the
217	// output is not the expected lead-in + JSON shape (e.g. the "kill" action's plain
218	// text), so the caller falls back to the raw text.
219	func formatManageSubagentsOutput(content string) string {
220		lead, objs, ok := splitLeadJSON(content)
221		if !ok {
222			return ""
223		}
224		var bullets []string
225		for _, o := range objs {
226			spec, _ := o["spec"].(map[string]any)
227			result, _ := o["result"].(map[string]any)
228			role := stringValue(spec, "role")
229			typeName := stringValue(spec, "typeName")
230			id := stringValue(result, "conversationId")
231	
232			label := role
233			if label == "" {
234				label = typeName
235			}
236			if label == "" && id == "" {
237				continue
238			}
239			line := "- "
240			if label != "" {
241				line += "**" + label + "**"
242			}
243			if typeName != "" && typeName != label {
244				line += " (`" + typeName + "`)"
245			}
246			if id != "" {
247				if label != "" {
248					line += " — "
249				}
250				line += "conversation `" + id + "`"
251			}
252			bullets = append(bullets, line)
253		}
254		if len(bullets) == 0 {
255			return ""
256		}
257		return joinOutput(defaultLead(lead, "Active subagents:"), bullets)
258	}
259	
260	// splitLeadJSON splits a tool result into its leading prose and the JSON
261	// value(s) that follow. It scans for the first line beginning a JSON object or
262	// array, treats everything before as the lead, and decodes the remainder as a
263	// stream of JSON values (tolerating agy's occasional multi-object output). It
264	// returns ok=false when no parseable JSON is present, so callers can fall back.
265	func splitLeadJSON(content string) (lead string, objs []map[string]any, ok bool) {
266		lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
267		start := -1
268		for i, line := range lines {
269			t := strings.TrimSpace(line)
270			if strings.HasPrefix(t, "{") || strings.HasPrefix(t, "[") {
271				start = i
272				break
273			}
274		}
275		if start == -1 {
276			return "", nil, false
277		}
278		lead = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(lines[:start], "\n"))
279	
280		dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines[start:], "\n")))
281		for {
282			var v any
283			err := dec.Decode(&v)
284			if err == io.EOF {
285				break
286			}
287			if err != nil {
288				if len(objs) == 0 {
289					return "", nil, false
290				}
291				break // stop at the first non-JSON trailing content, keep what parsed
292			}
293			switch t := v.(type) {
294			case map[string]any:
295				objs = append(objs, t)
296			case []any:
297				for _, e := range t {
298					if m, ok := e.(map[string]any); ok {
299						objs = append(objs, m)
300					}
301				}
302			}
303		}
304		if len(objs) == 0 {
305			return "", nil, false
306		}
307		return lead, objs, true
308	}
309	
310	// defaultLead returns lead, or fallback when lead is empty.
311	func defaultLead(lead, fallback string) string {
312		if lead != "" {
313			return lead
314		}
315		return fallback
316	}

318	// joinOutput assembles a summarized tool output: the "Output:" label, the lead
319	// sentence, then the bullet lines.
320	func joinOutput(lead string, bullets []string) string {
321		return fmt.Sprintf("Output: %s\n%s", lead, strings.Join(bullets, "\n"))
322	}

324	// extractPathHints surfaces filesystem paths referenced by a tool's input so
325	// downstream features (cloud sync, search) can index sessions by touched files.
326	func extractPathHints(input map[string]any, workspaceRoot string) []string {
327		if input == nil {
328			return nil
329		}
330	
331		pathFields := []string{
332			// Antigravity PascalCase keys.
333			"AbsolutePath", "TargetFile", "Cwd", "DirectoryPath", "SearchPath",
334			// Common variants, for forward-compatibility with unseen tools.
335			"path", "file_path", "file", "dir", "directory", "cwd", "workdir",
336		}
337		var hints []string
338		for _, field := range pathFields {
339			val, ok := input[field]
340			if !ok {
341				continue
342			}
343			switch v := val.(type) {
344			case string:
345				addPathHint(&hints, v, workspaceRoot)
346			case []any:
347				for _, entry := range v {
348					if s, ok := entry.(string); ok {
349						addPathHint(&hints, s, workspaceRoot)
350					}
351				}
352			}
353		}
354	
355		command := stringValue(input, "CommandLine", "command", "cmd")
356		if command != "" {
357			cwd := stringValue(input, "Cwd", "workdir", "cwd")
358			if cwd == "" {
359				cwd = workspaceRoot
360			}
361			for _, sp := range spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot) {
362				addPathHint(&hints, sp, workspaceRoot)
363			}
364		}
365	
366		return hints
367	}
368	
369	func addPathHint(hints *[]string, value string, workspaceRoot string) {
370		value = stripFileURI(strings.TrimSpace(value))
371		if value == "" {
372			return
373		}
374		normalized := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
375		for _, existing := range *hints {
376			if existing == normalized {
377				return
378			}
379		}
380		*hints = append(*hints, normalized)
381	}

509	func renderTodoWrite(args map[string]any) string {
510		itemsRaw, _ := args["todos"].([]any)
511		if len(itemsRaw) == 0 {
512			for _, key := range []string{"items", "plan", "steps"} {

514					itemsRaw = v
515					break

519		if len(itemsRaw) == 0 {
520			return renderGenericJSON(args)
521		}
522		var b strings.Builder
523		b.WriteString("Todo List:\n")
524		for _, raw := range itemsRaw {

526			if item == nil {
527				continue
528			}
529			status := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(item, "status"))
530			desc := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(item, "description", "content", "text"))
531			if desc == "" {
532				desc = "(no description)"
533			}
534			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- [%s] %s\n", todoSymbol(status), desc)
535		}
536		return strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")

539	// renderMultiEditInput renders a multi_replace_file_content call: the target
540	// file, the optional instruction, then one diff block per replacement chunk.
541	func renderMultiEditInput(args map[string]any) string {
542		path := stripFileURI(stringValue(args, "TargetFile", "file_path", "path", "file"))
543		chunks, _ := args["ReplacementChunks"].([]any)
544	
545		var b strings.Builder
546		if path != "" {
547			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Path: `%s`", path)
548		}
549		if instr := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(args, "Instruction")); instr != "" {
550			if b.Len() > 0 {
551				b.WriteString("\n\n")
552			}
553			b.WriteString(instr)
554		}
555	
556		var diffs []string
557		for _, raw := range chunks {
558			chunk, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
559			if chunk == nil {
560				continue
561			}
562			oldText := stringValue(chunk, "TargetContent")
563			newText := stringValue(chunk, "ReplacementContent")
564			if oldText == "" && newText == "" {
565				continue
566			}
567			diffs = append(diffs, formatDiffBlock(oldText, newText))
568		}
569		if len(diffs) > 0 {
570			if b.Len() > 0 {
571				b.WriteString("\n\n")
572			}
573			b.WriteString(strings.Join(diffs, "\n\n"))
574		}
575	
576		if b.Len() == 0 {
577			return renderGenericJSON(args)
578		}
579		return b.String()
580	}

582	// renderGenerateImageInput renders a generate_image call: the image name and
583	// aspect ratio, then the generation prompt.

589			return renderGenericJSON(args)
590		}

592		var parts []string
593		switch {
594		case name != "" && aspect != "":
595			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Image: `%s` (aspect ratio `%s`)", name, aspect))
596		case name != "":
597			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Image: `%s`", name))
598		case aspect != "":
599			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Aspect ratio: `%s`", aspect))
600		}
601		if prompt != "" {
602			parts = append(parts, "Prompt: "+prompt)
603		}
604		return strings.Join(parts, "\n\n")

637	// renderInvokeSubagentInput renders an invoke_subagent call as a bullet per
638	// spawned subagent: its role, type, model, and prompt.
639	func renderInvokeSubagentInput(args map[string]any) string {
640		subs, _ := args["Subagents"].([]any)
641		if len(subs) == 0 {
642			return renderGenericJSON(args)
643		}
644	
645		var b strings.Builder
646		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Invoking %d subagent(s):\n", len(subs))
647		for _, raw := range subs {
648			sub, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
649			if sub == nil {
650				continue
651			}
652			role := stringValue(sub, "Role", "role")
653			typeName := stringValue(sub, "TypeName", "type_name")
654			model := stringValue(sub, "Model", "model")
655			prompt := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(sub, "Prompt", "prompt"))
656	
657			label := role
658			if label == "" {
659				label = typeName
660			}
661			var meta []string
662			if typeName != "" && typeName != label {
663				meta = append(meta, "`"+typeName+"`")
664			}
665			if model != "" {
666				meta = append(meta, "model `"+model+"`")
667			}
668	
669			line := "- **" + label + "**"
670			if len(meta) > 0 {
671				line += " (" + strings.Join(meta, ", ") + ")"
672			}
673			if prompt != "" {
674				line += ": " + prompt
675			}
676			b.WriteString(line + "\n")
677		}
678		return strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")
679	}

681	// renderManageInput renders an Action-based management call (manage_task,
682	// manage_subagents): the action verb and the target ids it operates on. idKeys
683	// lists the argument keys that may carry the target id(s), each a string or a
684	// list of strings.
685	func renderManageInput(args map[string]any, idLabel string, idKeys ...string) string {
686		var parts []string
687		if action := stringValue(args, "Action", "action"); action != "" {
688			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Action: `%s`", action))
689		}
690		if ids := collectStringList(args, idKeys...); len(ids) > 0 {
691			quoted := make([]string, len(ids))
692			for i, id := range ids {
693				quoted[i] = "`" + id + "`"
694			}
695			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", idLabel, strings.Join(quoted, ", ")))
696		}
697		if len(parts) == 0 {
698			return renderGenericJSON(args)
699		}
700		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
701	}

746	// renderAskQuestionInput renders an ask_question call: each question in bold
747	// followed by its selectable options as a bullet list. The user's answer arrives
748	// in the tool output and is rendered by formatToolOutput.
749	func renderAskQuestionInput(args map[string]any) string {
750		questions, _ := args["questions"].([]any)
751		if len(questions) == 0 {
752			return renderGenericJSON(args)
753		}
754	
755		var b strings.Builder
756		for qi, raw := range questions {
757			q, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
758			if q == nil {
759				continue
760			}
761			text := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(q, "question"))
762			if text == "" {
763				continue
764			}
765			if qi > 0 {
766				b.WriteString("\n")
767			}
768			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "**%s**", text)
769			if multi, ok := q["is_multi_select"].(bool); ok && multi {
770				b.WriteString(" _(select multiple)_")
771			}
772			b.WriteString("\n")
773			options, _ := q["options"].([]any)
774			for _, opt := range options {
775				if s, ok := opt.(string); ok {
776					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", s)
777				}
778			}
779		}
780		out := strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")
781		if out == "" {
782			return renderGenericJSON(args)
783		}
784		return out
785	}
786	
787	func formatDiffBlock(oldText, newText string) string {
788		var b strings.Builder
789		b.WriteString("```diff\n")
790		if oldText != "" {
791			for _, line := range strings.Split(oldText, "\n") {
792				b.WriteString("-")
793				b.WriteString(line)
794				b.WriteString("\n")
795			}
796		}
797		if newText != "" {
798			for _, line := range strings.Split(newText, "\n") {
799				b.WriteString("+")
800				b.WriteString(line)
801				b.WriteString("\n")
802			}
803		}
804		b.WriteString("```")
805		return b.String()
806	}
807	
808	func formatContentBlock(content, path string) string {
809		lang := languageFromPath(path)
810		escaped := strings.ReplaceAll(content, "```", "\\```")
811		if lang == "" {
812			return fmt.Sprintf("```\n%s\n```", escaped)
813		}
814		return fmt.Sprintf("```%s\n%s\n```", lang, escaped)
815	}
816	
817	func languageFromPath(path string) string {
818		if path == "" {
819			return ""
820		}
821		ext := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(path)), ".")
822		if ext == "" {
823			return ""
824		}
825		switch ext {
826		case "yml":
827			return "yaml"
828		case "md":
829			return "markdown"
830		default:
831			return ext
832		}
833	}
834	
835	// --- generic helpers ---
836	
837	func renderGenericJSON(args map[string]any) string {
838		keys := make([]string, 0, len(args))
839		for k := range args {
840			// toolAction/toolSummary are agy-injected human labels present on every
841			// call, not real arguments; drop them so the fallback shows only real args.
842			if k == "toolAction" || k == "toolSummary" {
843				continue
844			}
845			keys = append(keys, k)
846		}
847		if len(keys) == 0 {
848			return ""
849		}
850		sort.Strings(keys)
851		var b strings.Builder
852		b.WriteString("```json\n{")
853		for i, k := range keys {
854			if i > 0 {
855				b.WriteString(",")
856			}
857			b.WriteString("\n  \"")
858			b.WriteString(k)
859			b.WriteString("\": ")
860			b.WriteString(renderJSONValue(args[k]))
861		}
862		b.WriteString("\n}\n```")
863		return b.String()
864	}
865	
866	func renderJSONValue(v any) string {
867		switch val := v.(type) {
868		case string:
869			bytes, _ := json.Marshal(val)
870			return string(bytes)
871		case json.Number:
872			return val.String()
873		default:
874			bytes, err := json.Marshal(val)
875			if err != nil {
876				return fmt.Sprintf("%q", fmt.Sprint(val))
877			}
878			return string(bytes)
879		}
880	}
881	
882	// collectStringList gathers string values from args across the given keys. Each
883	// key's value may be a single string or a list of strings; empties are skipped.
884	func collectStringList(args map[string]any, keys ...string) []string {
885		var out []string
886		for _, key := range keys {
887			val, ok := args[key]
888			if !ok {
889				continue
890			}
891			switch v := val.(type) {
892			case string:
893				if v != "" {
894					out = append(out, v)
895				}
896			case []any:
897				for _, entry := range v {
898					if s, ok := entry.(string); ok && s != "" {
899						out = append(out, s)
900					}
901				}
902			}
903		}
904		return out
905	}
906	
907	// blockquote prefixes each line of text with "> " so multi-line prompts render as
908	// a markdown blockquote.
909	func blockquote(text string) string {
910		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(text), "\n")
911		for i, line := range lines {
912			lines[i] = "> " + line
913		}
914		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
915	}
916	
917	func stringValue(args map[string]any, keys ...string) string {
918		for _, key := range keys {
919			val, ok := args[key]
920			if !ok {
921				continue
922			}
923			switch v := val.(type) {
924			case string:
925				return v
926			case json.Number:
927				return v.String()
928			case float64:
929				return strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'f', -1, 64)
930			case int:
931				return strconv.Itoa(v)
932			case int64:
933				return strconv.FormatInt(v, 10)
934			case bool:
935				return strconv.FormatBool(v)
936			}
937		}
938		return ""
939	}

941	func normalizeToolName(name string) string {
942		cleaned := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name))
943		cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, " ", "")
944		cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, "-", "")
945		cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, "_", "")
946		return cleaned
947	}
948	
949	func todoSymbol(status string) string {
950		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status)) {
951		case "completed", "done":
952			return "x"
953		case "in_progress", "active":
954			return "⚡"
955		default:
956			return " "

958	}

```text
1	package antigravitycli
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"log/slog"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9	
10		"github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify"
11		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
12	)
13	
14	// watchState tracks the last-processed modification time per transcript file so
15	// the same content is not re-emitted on every filesystem event.
16	type watchState struct {
17		lastProcessed map[string]int64
18	}
19	
20	// watchSessions watches Antigravity CLI transcripts for new or modified content
21	// and invokes sessionCallback for each change. Antigravity stores each
22	// conversation's transcript deep under brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/, and
23	// fsnotify is non-recursive, so we maintain a watch on the brain directory plus
24	// each nested directory level and extend the watches as new ones appear.
25	func watchSessions(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
26		if sessionCallback == nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("session callback is required")
28		}
29	
30		brainDir, err := resolveBrainDir()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34	
35		watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
36		if err != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("antigravity: failed to create watcher: %w", err)
38		}
39		defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }()
40	
41		state := &watchState{lastProcessed: make(map[string]int64)}
42	
43		// Initial scan so existing sessions are emitted immediately.
44		if err := scanAndProcessConversations(projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state); err != nil {
45			slog.Debug("antigravity: initial scan failed", "error", err)
46		}
47	
48		if err := setupWatches(watcher, brainDir); err != nil {
49			slog.Debug("antigravity: setup watches failed", "error", err)
50		}
51	
52		for {
53			select {
54			case <-ctx.Done():
55				return ctx.Err()
56			case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
57				if !ok {
58					return nil
59				}
60				handleWatchEvent(event, watcher, brainDir, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state)
61			case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
62				if !ok {
63					return nil
64				}
65				slog.Debug("antigravity: watcher error", "error", err)
66			}
67		}
68	}
69	
70	// setupWatches (re)establishes the watch set. If the brain directory does not
71	// exist yet it watches the nearest existing ancestor so brain/ creation is
72	// noticed; otherwise it watches brain/ and every nested conversation directory
73	// level that currently exists. It is idempotent — re-adding an existing watch is
74	// a no-op — so it is safe to call on every relevant event.
75	func setupWatches(watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, brainDir string) error {
76		if _, err := os.Stat(brainDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
77			ancestor := nearestExistingDir(filepath.Dir(brainDir))
78			if ancestor == "" {
79				return nil
80			}
81			slog.Debug("antigravity: brain dir missing, watching ancestor", "path", ancestor)
82			return watcher.Add(ancestor)
83		}
84	
85		if err := watcher.Add(brainDir); err != nil {
86			return err
87		}
88		addConversationWatches(watcher, brainDir)
89		return nil
90	}
91	
92	// addConversationWatches adds a watch on each existing nested directory level of
93	// every conversation (<id>, <id>/.system_generated, and the logs dir that
94	// directly holds the transcript). Levels that don't exist yet are added later as
95	// their parent's Create event arrives.
96	func addConversationWatches(watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, brainDir string) {
97		entries, err := os.ReadDir(brainDir)
98		if err != nil {
99			return
100		}
101		for _, entry := range entries {
102			if !entry.IsDir() {
103				continue
104			}
105			idDir := filepath.Join(brainDir, entry.Name())
106			levels := []string{
107				idDir,
108				filepath.Join(idDir, systemGeneratedDir),
109				filepath.Join(idDir, systemGeneratedDir, logsDirName),
110			}
111			for _, dir := range levels {
112				if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
113					_ = watcher.Add(dir)
114				}
115			}
116		}
117	}
118	
119	// nearestExistingDir walks up from dir and returns the first existing directory,
120	// or "" if none is found before reaching the filesystem root.
121	func nearestExistingDir(dir string) string {
122		for dir != "" && dir != "." {
123			if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
124				return dir
125			}
126			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
127			if parent == dir {
128				return ""
129			}
130			dir = parent
131		}
132		return ""
133	}
134	
135	// handleWatchEvent processes a filesystem event: directory creation extends the
136	// watch set (and triggers a scan when the brain dir itself appears), while a
137	// transcript write/create is parsed and dispatched.
138	func handleWatchEvent(event fsnotify.Event, watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, brainDir string, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) {
139		slog.Debug("antigravity: received fs event", "op", event.Op.String(), "path", event.Name)
140	
141		if event.Has(fsnotify.Create) {
142			if info, err := os.Stat(event.Name); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
143				// A new directory appeared somewhere in the chain (possibly brain/
144				// itself, or a new conversation's nested dirs). Re-establish watches
145				// so the eventual transcript write is caught.
146				if err := setupWatches(watcher, brainDir); err != nil {
147					slog.Debug("antigravity: re-setup watches failed", "error", err)
148				}
149				if event.Name == brainDir {
150					if err := scanAndProcessConversations(projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state); err != nil {
151						slog.Debug("antigravity: scan after brain create failed", "error", err)
152					}
153				}
154				return
155			}
156		}
157	
158		if !isTranscriptPath(event.Name) {
159			return
160		}
161		if !event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && !event.Has(fsnotify.Write) {
162			return
163		}
164		processTranscriptFile(event.Name, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state)
165	}
166	
167	// isTranscriptPath reports whether a path is a conversation transcript file.
168	func isTranscriptPath(path string) bool {
169		base := filepath.Base(path)
170		return base == transcriptFileName || base == fallbackTranscriptFileName
171	}
172	
173	// conversationIDFromTranscriptPath recovers the conversation id (the brain
174	// subdirectory name) from a transcript path of the form
175	// brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl.
176	func conversationIDFromTranscriptPath(transcriptPath string) string {
177		logsDir := filepath.Dir(transcriptPath)
178		sysDir := filepath.Dir(logsDir)
179		idDir := filepath.Dir(sysDir)
180		return filepath.Base(idDir)
181	}
182	
183	// processTranscriptFile parses and dispatches a single transcript if it changed
184	// since last processed and matches the project filter.
185	func processTranscriptFile(transcriptPath string, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) {
186		conversationID := conversationIDFromTranscriptPath(transcriptPath)
187		if conversationID == "" {
188			return
189		}
190	
191		if preferredPath, err := resolveTranscriptPath(conversationID); err == nil && preferredPath != "" {
192			transcriptPath = preferredPath
193		} else if err != nil {
194			slog.Debug("antigravity: unable to resolve preferred transcript", "conversationId", conversationID, "error", err)
195			return
196		} else {
197			return
198		}
199	
200		info, err := os.Stat(transcriptPath)
201		if err != nil {
202			return
203		}
204		modTime := info.ModTime().UnixNano()
205		if last, ok := state.lastProcessed[transcriptPath]; ok && last >= modTime {
206			return
207		}
208	
209		history, _ := loadHistoryIndex()
210		projectWorkspaces, _ := loadConversationWorkspaceIndex()
211		session, err := parseTranscript(conversationID, transcriptPath, history, projectWorkspaces, true)
212		if err != nil {
213			slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping session", "path", transcriptPath, "error", err)
214			return
215		}
216		if !sessionMatchesProject(session, projectPath) {
217			return
218		}
219		chat := convertToAgentSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
220		if chat == nil {
221			return
222		}
223	
224		state.lastProcessed[transcriptPath] = modTime
225		dispatchSession(sessionCallback, chat)
226	}
227	
228	// scanAndProcessConversations processes every conversation that has changed
229	// since last seen.
230	func scanAndProcessConversations(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) error {
231		files, err := listConversationFiles()
232		if err != nil {
233			return err
234		}
235		history, _ := loadHistoryIndex()
236		projectWorkspaces, _ := loadConversationWorkspaceIndex()
237	
238		for _, file := range files {
239			if last, ok := state.lastProcessed[file.Path]; ok && last >= file.ModTime {
240				continue
241			}
242			session, err := parseTranscript(file.ConversationID, file.Path, history, projectWorkspaces, true)
243			if err != nil {
244				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping session", "path", file.Path, "error", err)
245				continue
246			}
247			if !sessionMatchesProject(session, projectPath) {
248				continue
249			}
250			chat := convertToAgentSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
251			if chat == nil {
252				continue
253			}
254			state.lastProcessed[file.Path] = file.ModTime
255			dispatchSession(sessionCallback, chat)
256		}
257		return nil
258	}
259	
260	// dispatchSession invokes the session callback in a goroutine with panic
261	// recovery so a misbehaving callback cannot crash the watcher.
262	func dispatchSession(sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), session *spi.AgentChatSession) {
263		if sessionCallback == nil || session == nil {
264			return
265		}
266		go func() {
267			defer func() {
268				if r := recover(); r != nil {
269					slog.Error("antigravity: session callback panicked", "panic", r)
270				}
271			}()
272			sessionCallback(session)
273		}()
274	}
```

```text
1	package antigravitycli
2	
3	import (
4		"log/slog"
5		"os"
6		"os/exec"
7		"path/filepath"
8		"slices"
9		"strings"
10	
11		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
12	)
13	
14	const (
15		// defaultCommand is the Antigravity CLI launcher. The installed binary is
16		// `agy` (an `antigravity` alias exists but is not normally on PATH).
17		defaultCommand = "agy"
18		versionFlag    = "--version"
19		// resumeFlag continues a specific conversation by id; `-c` (most recent) is
20		// the alternative the CLI offers but we always target a known id.
21		resumeFlag = "--conversation"
22	)
23	
24	// expandTilde expands a leading ~ to the user's home directory so users can
25	// configure custom commands like "~/bin/agy".
26	func expandTilde(path string) string {
27		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") {
28			return path
29		}
30		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
31		if err != nil {
32			return path
33		}
34		return filepath.Join(home, path[2:])
35	}
36	
37	// parseCommand splits a custom command string into executable name and args,
38	// returning the default command when customCommand is empty.
39	func parseCommand(customCommand string) (string, []string) {
40		if strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != "" {
41			parts := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
42			if len(parts) > 0 {
43				return expandTilde(parts[0]), parts[1:]
44			}
45		}
46		return defaultCommand, nil
47	}
48	
49	// ExecuteAntigravity launches the Antigravity CLI and blocks until it exits.
50	func ExecuteAntigravity(customCommand string, resumeSessionID string) error {
51		cmdName, args := parseCommand(customCommand)
52		args = ensureResumeArgs(args, resumeSessionID)
53		if resumeSessionID != "" {
54			slog.Info("ExecuteAntigravity: resuming conversation", "conversationId", resumeSessionID)
55		}
56	
57		command := exec.Command(cmdName, args...)
58		command.Stdin = os.Stdin
59		command.Stdout = os.Stdout
60		command.Stderr = os.Stderr
61	
62		return command.Run()
63	}
64	
65	// ensureResumeArgs adds --conversation <id> to args when resuming, unless the
66	// caller already supplied a conversation flag with a value.
67	func ensureResumeArgs(args []string, resumeSessionID string) []string {
68		if resumeSessionID == "" {
69			return args
70		}
71	
72		for i, arg := range args {
73			if arg == resumeFlag {
74				if i+1 < len(args) && strings.TrimSpace(args[i+1]) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
75					return args
76				}
77				// slices.Concat always allocates a new backing array, so the caller's
78				// slice is never mutated.
79				return slices.Concat(args[:i+1], []string{resumeSessionID}, args[i+1:])
80			}
81			if strings.HasPrefix(arg, resumeFlag+"=") {
82				if strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(arg, resumeFlag+"=")) != "" {
83					return args
84				}
85				repaired := slices.Clone(args)
86				repaired[i] = resumeFlag + "=" + resumeSessionID
87				return repaired
88			}
89		}
90	
91		return append(args, resumeFlag, resumeSessionID)
92	}
```

```text
8	// Compile-time assertion that Provider satisfies the full spi.Provider contract.
9	// The interface conformance is otherwise only exercised at registration in the
10	// factory package, so a locally missing method fails there rather than here;
11	// this guard surfaces the gap in the provider's own package.
12	var _ spi.Provider = (*Provider)(nil)
13	
14	// ReconstructSession is unsupported for Antigravity. On resume, `agy` rebuilds
15	// conversation state from the per-conversation SQLite store
16	// (conversations/<id>.db, protobuf step payloads) — NOT from the plaintext
17	// transcript this provider parses (verified empirically; see
18	// docs/antigravity-format-spec.md §1.1). A resumable reconstruction would
19	// therefore have to synthesize that protobuf-in-SQLite store, so the
20	// text-serializer approach the other providers use cannot produce a session
21	// `agy` will actually resume. Until such a serializer exists, this provider
22	// carries the interface method but declines to reconstruct.
23	func (p *Provider) ReconstructSession(data *schema.SessionData, opts spi.ReconstructOptions) (*spi.ReconstructedSession, error) {
24		return nil, spi.ErrReconstructionUnsupported
25	}
26	
27	// NativeSessionPath is unsupported for the same reason as ReconstructSession:
28	// there is no plaintext session file this provider can write that `agy` would
29	// resume from, so there is no native path to resolve.
30	func (p *Provider) NativeSessionPath(projectPath string, filename string) (string, error) {
31		return "", spi.ErrReconstructionUnsupported
32	}
```

```text
}

func normalizeToolName(name string) string {
	cleaned := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name))
	cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, " ", "")
	cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, "-", "")
	cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, "_", "")
	return cleaned
}

func todoSymbol(status string) string {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status)) {
	case "completed", "done":
		return "x"
	case "in_progress", "active":
		return "⚡"
	default:
		return " "
	}
}
--- deepseek stringValue:
func stringValue(args map[string]any, keys ...string) string {
	for _, key := range keys {
		val, ok := args[key]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		switch v := val.(type) {
		case string:
			return v
		case json.Number:
			return v.String()
		case float64:
			return strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'f', -1, 64)
		case int:
			return strconv.Itoa(v)
		case int64:
			return strconv.FormatInt(v, 10)
		case bool:
			return strconv.FormatBool(v)
		}
	}
	return ""
}
=== deepseek dispatchSession
func dispatchSession(sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), session *spi.AgentChatSession) {
	if sessionCallback == nil || session == nil {
		return
	}
	go func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				slog.Error("deepseek: session callback panicked", "panic", r)
			}
		}()
		sessionCallback(session)
	}()
}
=== deepseek canonicalizePath
func canonicalizePath(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(trimmed)
	if err == nil {
		return canonical
	}
	if abs, err := filepath.Abs(trimmed); err == nil {
		return filepath.Clean(abs)
	}
	return filepath.Clean(trimmed)
}
```

```text
162		// Two pending tool calls; two results should attach in order (FIFO).
163		current := &Exchange{Messages: []Message{
164			{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &ToolInfo{Name: "run_command", Input: map[string]any{"CommandLine": "a"}}},
165			{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &ToolInfo{Name: "run_command", Input: map[string]any{"CommandLine": "b"}}},
166		}}
167	
168		attachToolResult(transcriptStep{Type: typeRunCommand, Content: "result-A"}, current, nil)
169		attachToolResult(transcriptStep{Type: typeRunCommand, Content: "result-B"}, current, nil)
170	
171		if out, _ := current.Messages[0].Tool.Output["content"].(string); out != "result-A" {
172			t.Errorf("first tool got %q, want result-A", out)
173		}
174		if out, _ := current.Messages[1].Tool.Output["content"].(string); out != "result-B" {
175			t.Errorf("second tool got %q, want result-B", out)
176		}
177	
178		// An orphan result (no pending tool) must not panic or misattribute.
179		attachToolResult(transcriptStep{Type: typeRunCommand, Content: "orphan"}, current, nil)
180		if out, _ := current.Messages[1].Tool.Output["content"].(string); out != "result-B" {
181			t.Errorf("orphan result overwrote a resolved tool: got %q", out)
182		}
```
